items.text: This game is great but just and FYI you can't remove of install air locks anywhere other than there starting position and don't ever uninstall your transponder. It's illegal to have a ship without it and there 25000 a pop.
items.text_zh: 这个游戏很棒，但只是提醒一下，你只能在气闸的初始位置移除或安装气闸，其他地方都不行，而且千万不要卸载你的应答器。没有它是违法的，而且每个要25000。

observations.description: 气闸只能在初始位置安装或拆除
observations.evidence: you can't remove of install air locks anywhere other than there starting position
observations.evidence_zh: 除了起始位置之外，你不能在任何其他地方移除或安装气闸
